captions: The actual Eplyx intro loads into the interactive homepage.
What happens when you change an onchain system?
Pin the transaction, accounts, program bytes and historical runtime. Verify their hashes.
Run the baseline and candidate against the same transaction and state.
Compare logs, CPIs, account state and economic outcomes. Causal checkpoint boundaries remain explicit.
Orca SwapV2 measures user input and vault flows from account-state changes.
Drift settlePnl measures the bounded settlement. Unsupported quantities remain unevaluated.
Open the retained upgrade run. ChangeSpec binds its target and exact candidate bytes.
Read the impact: this controlled candidate breaks tested historical interactions.
G1 checks that the Squads proposal and buffer match the analysed change.
G2 checks execution and attributable deployed bytes. This archived proposal has not executed.
Run a local migration rehearsal. The dashboard then loads its saved records.
Technical mode reveals exact values and hashes without changing the analytical result.
Inspect the stress matrix. At the deadline, this defect candidate succeeds when rejection is required.
Follow the failing case to the deployment gate. Nineteen of twenty cases behaved as specified.
The witness retains the account, expected rejection, actual success and fixture provenance.
Copy its reproduction command and replay the same stored bytes offline.
Select reference and candidate runs, then compare the retained records.
Check funding, code, readiness and search comparability. A missing finding alone is not a proven fix.
The current-state form loads. Enter a public mint and owner; no wallet connection is needed.
Click Observe. Eplyx reads bounded account state and retains the observation.
The observed accounts appear and offline analysis is queued. Observation alone is not execution proof.
Choose Transfer, the exact amount and recipient token account.
Eplyx captures final state and queues the offline path check. Waiting time is condensed.
Read the actual result: local execution performed, no funds moved, signing possession cannot be judged.
Declare the replacement mint, amount, ratio and reserve for the candidate.
Retain immutable inputs and execute the candidate locally. Waiting time is condensed.
The exact account check passes. This does not establish population readiness or an official transition.
Bind a saved plan, successor, effective date and deadline to a hypothetical lifecycle scenario.
Evaluate declared policy against retained evidence. Waiting time is condensed.
Read each assurance separately: a ready candidate does not mean readiness for every holder.
CLI and local dashboard: analyse, search, gate, inspect and reproduce.
Hosted workspace and browser: exact-byte sync, observe, check a path and evaluate a scenario.
Eplyx. Know what changes before you deploy.
